summary.title: Summary
summary.content: Software Engineer with expertise in scalable infrastructure architecture, agentic AI application development, and cloud-native deployment on AWS and GCP. Experienced building cost-optimized multi-model AI pipelines, real-time data platforms, and developer tools. Focused on high-impact systems that combine automation intelligence with production-grade reliability.

items.description:
• Reduced a multi-hour daily job search to minutes by designing an automated ingestion pipeline that aggregates, deduplicates, and ranks opportunities across multiple sources.
  • Designed and implemented a real-time scoring engine for a football prediction platform, processing live match data and recalculating leaderboards across competing leagues as games finish.
  • Deployed and maintained both applications in production, setting up observability and alerting to catch issues early and keep scheduled pipelines running reliably without manual intervention.

• Engineered and operated a distributed platform handling 10M+ user data imports per day, achieving sub-second processing latency and uninterrupted customer access worldwide.
  • Improved product reliability and user trust by developing a scalable, observable data management framework that increased system availability, reduced outages, and accelerated root-cause analysis through real-time monitoring and alerting.
  • Mentored junior developers, fostering their understanding and application of best practices through code reviews and reoccurring meetings.
  • Reduced average query response time by 40% and improved system throughput by 60% by optimizing SQL queries and introducing asynchronous processing, leading to faster, more reliable user interactions.
  • Led cross-functional collaboration to design and implement enterprise-grade entitlement and access control systems, bolstering security and compliance across the platform.
  • Spearheaded the creation of an asynchronous user provisioning pipeline, decoupling onboarding from app setup to increase scalability, reduce latency, and improve customer experience.

• Contributed to the development of a cloud-based payments personalization platform.
  • Led the design of a scalable microservices architecture and a redesigned job framework, improving platform performance, reliability, and customer experience at scale.
  • Built and maintained high-reliability CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, achieving a 100% deployment success rate and accelerating delivery.
  • Mentored junior engineers through code reviews and pair programming, elevating code quality and team effectiveness.
  • Delivered measurable impact by optimizing server response times and implementing asynchronous job processing, directly contributing to client acquisition growth.

• Contributed to the development of enterprise software for experiential marketing, enabling brands to design, manage, and measure live events and consumer interactions that drove engagement and sales.
  • Designed and developed advanced software projects for deployment in various products.
  • Partnered with product management to evaluate requirements and deliver intuitive, high-quality software interfaces that exceeded client expectations.
  • Developed and integrated application components using Spring MVC, improving maintainability, reliability, and scalability of the platform.
  • Contributed as a core member of a three-person team to design and launch the v2 dashboard application, significantly enhancing customer experience and product adoption.

• Developed robust Java code for enterprise applications.
  • Wrote, modified, and maintained software documentation and specifications.
  • Efficiently developed high-quality code by creating unit tests where necessary to ensure automated testing.
  • Key Achievements: Successfully built a microservice to integrate with clients.
